caption: Plans in the app: Basic $10 a month for 1 active pixel, Standard $15 for 5 and Unlimited $30, each with a 14 day trial; development stores are not charged.
On our development store Shopify showed Unlimited at $30 every 30 days as a test charge that is not billed, with no card asked.
When adding a pixel you type its ID and can pick collections it applies to; no Facebook login was needed.
Two test pixels saved and active: one for all products and one only for the Hydrogen collection. Server side API stayed off.
